top_signals.summary:

GenAI.mil hit 1.5 million users in six months, and I have heard enough OpenAI-in-disguise pitches to last a lifetime. The adoption really is great, but the poster contains a problem. “Use” is the verb of tools, and the Department of Defense does not win by using tools. top_signals.title: Ninth Circuit Opinion Provided 'More Confusion Than Clarity,' Said Kalshi Board Member
top_signals.summary: Brian Quintenz, KalshiEx Board Member and former CFTC Commissioner, said that the recent decision handed down by the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals provided the company and customers 'more confusion than clarity' when it ruled sports prediction markets can be prosecuted as unlicensed sportsbooks. Quintenz said that prediction market regulation will come down to the Supreme Court to define and that within the law events that have 'any financial, commercial or economic consequence' can have legal derivatives listed upon it because it involved risk.  (Source: Bloomberg)

alerts.title: U.S. uranium production more than tripled in 2025 and was the highest since 2017
alerts.summary: In 2025, uranium concentrate production in the United States totaled 2.1 million pounds of triuranium octoxide (U3O8), the base component of nuclear reactor fuel. U.S. U3O8 production in 2025 was the most since 2017 and more than triple the volume produced in 2024.
